claude_proposed_widenings.name: ignore_web_entrapment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants immunity to being caught by webs specifically, not a blanket immunity to a core condition. Existing condition-immunity atoms are too broad.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can't be caught in webs of any sort"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ignore_specific_terrain_cost
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface cannot currently express moving through one named terrain or hazard with reduced movement cost while leaving all other terrain rules unchanged.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.areaOverride.relative_area_multiplier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current area override only supports absolute replacement geometry. This rule is a relative multiplier on the granted spell's normal area.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area"
